svg.title: MCP-Doctor diagnostic security boundary
svg.desc: Safe local configuration validation and explicit, bounded local stdio checking are included. Untrusted shell command strings, active tools/call, remote URL transport, telemetry, and uploads are excluded. Sensitive data scrubbing is best-effort.
svg.text: What MCP-Doctor allows—and what it deliberately avoids
Security boundaries are part of the product behavior, not just documentation.
✓ Read config JSON without launching commands
✓ Start one selected stdio server only via explicit check
✓ shell=False with command/args as separate values
✓ Separate stderr drain; do not report raw stderr
✓ Local text / JSON report; no telemetry or upload
× Remote URL / HTTP probing in this release
× Automatically trusting an unknown server command
× Guaranteeing every secret is detected or removed
× Uploading configs, logs, or findings to a hosted service
RUN ONLY TRUSTED CONFIGURED COMMANDS · REDACTION IS BEST-EFFORT · REVIEW REPORTS BEFORE SHARING
